Represents the settings for an input action, including hold duration, multi-tap duration, and multi-tap target.

Constructors

InputActionSettings()

Initializes a new instance of InputActionSettings with default values. HoldDuration is set to 1 second, MultiTapDuration to 0.25 seconds, MultiTapTarget to 0, AxisGravity to 1, and AxisSensitivity to 1.

Parameters

holdDuration float

The duration required to trigger a hold action (in seconds).

tapDuration float

The duration allowed between taps for a multi-tap action (in seconds).

multiTapTarget int

The number of taps required for a multi-tap action.

axisSensitivity float

How fast an axis moves towards the max value (in seconds).

axisGravitiy float

How fast an axis moves towards 0 after no input is detected (in seconds).
